data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 inherits from SRC_004: the requirement for causal firebreaks (independent codebases, power domains) is a specific implementation of the general topological requirement for a modular, loosely-coupled DAG, because causal firebreaks enforce the edges that make the dependency graph acyclic and prevent cascading failures. Refuted if a system can possess causal firebreaks while maintaining a cyclic dependency topology that still allows cascading failures under specific load conditions.
